output.content:
Comparing glucose in **CHO-007-R02 minus CHO-007-R01** (exact matched elapsed sample times, 9 matched pairs from 0 to 146 h, g/L, provisional CMO data):

- **Mean signed difference: −0.207 g/L** (CHO-007-R02 runs lower on average)
- **Largest absolute difference: 0.555 g/L at 18 h** — CHO-007-R01 was 7.83 g/L vs CHO-007-R02 at 7.275 g/L

These come from the "Northfield Biologics · November runs" CMO delivery, which — like the Northfield October and Harborview fed-batch deliveries in your review list — is still **provisional**: values were read from the delivery files and have not been reviewed, so verify the delivery before relying on them. The comparison at 18 h in particular uses values flagged by an unresolved duplicate conflict (CHO-007-R02, 44 h) in the same delivery, and CHO-007-R01's 44 h sample had no exact match in CHO-007-R02 (90% of samples matched). Statistics are descriptive only; no significance test applies since successive samples of one run are not independent.
